statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains below the WATCH threshold while post-FOMC rates pressure is offset by two-way equity behavior and easing oil.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON; the next concentrated risk checkpoint is the 12:30 UTC U.S. data cluster and subsequent cash-open price discovery.
headline: Post-FOMC futures firm as rates stay restrictive; Tail remains low
body: Latest verified overnight reporting showed Nasdaq futures up 0.6%, the 2-year Treasury yield near 4.71%, the 10-year near 4.99%, and the dollar at a seven-week high after the Fed hike. Brent eased and VIX closed at 17.71. This is a high-Stress cross-asset mix, but no independently verified repeated failed-retracement NQ sequence is available at the cutoff.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 hourly publications, Tail rose from low into WATCH/elevated around the FOMC sequence, peaked at 25% at 20:08 UTC, then decayed to 18% by 03:09 UTC as two-way conditions reasserted.
outlookSummary: Conditional Tail stays low through early Europe, rises into WATCH around the 12:30 UTC U.S. claims, housing and Philly Fed cluster plus the cash-open sequence, then decays if price discovery remains two-way with meaningful retracements.

forecast.analysis: Latest verified overnight reporting showed Nasdaq futures up 0.6% while 2Y yields held near 4.71%, the dollar at a seven-week high and Brent lower. VIX closed 17.71. Stress remains high, but no verified sequence of failed NQ retracements supports a Tail block.
drivers: Nasdaq futures +0.6% in latest verified Reuters reporting
2Y yield near 4.71% and dollar at seven-week high
Brent easing after the prior energy spike

news.title: Shares tick higher as Fed hikes rates, dollar jumps with short-term yields

forecast.analysis: If the overnight bid remains orderly rather than extending through repeated failed pullbacks, Tail stays low; firm short yields and the dollar keep Stress elevated.
drivers: Orderly overnight bid is the low-Tail base case
Short yields remain a macro headwind
Repeated failed pullbacks would invalidate the low-Tail path

forecast.analysis: The European handoff can test the overnight bid. Tail remains low unless NQ begins holding near highs with shallow retracements while rates and the dollar stay aligned.
drivers: Retracement depth is the key Tail discriminator
Rates-dollar alignment remains a conditional amplifier

forecast.analysis: As European liquidity deepens, two-way price discovery would keep Tail low; persistent directional efficiency alongside firm yields would challenge that assumption.
drivers: Persistent directional efficiency would raise Tail

forecast.analysis: The U.S. data cluster is still several hours away. Tail stays low absent one-way NQ structure, while event proximity gradually keeps Stress from normalizing.
drivers: One-way NQ structure remains the invalidation

forecast.analysis: Pre-U.S. positioning becomes more relevant. Conditional risk rises modestly if futures hold an extreme without meaningful retracement, but event importance alone does not justify a block.
drivers: Session-extreme holding would be meaningful Tail evidence

forecast.analysis: Approaching the 12:30 UTC releases, Stress rises while Tail remains below WATCH unless current price structure independently turns one-way.
drivers: Stress rises ahead of scheduled data
Tail still requires observed one-way structure

forecast.analysis: Within roughly 90 minutes of the claims, housing and Philly Fed cluster, conditional Tail enters WATCH as liquidity can thin; escalation still requires persistent extension or failed retracements.
drivers: Claims, housing and Philly Fed cluster ahead
Persistent extension is required for a block

forecast.analysis: The 12:30 UTC release cluster sits inside this hour. WATCH reflects concentrated repricing risk; a block would require the actual post-release path to deny meaningful mean reversion.
drivers: Philadelphia Fed manufacturing survey at 12:30 UTC

forecast.analysis: This hour spans initial post-data discovery and the approach to the U.S. cash open. WATCH persists conditionally until retracement quality and cross-asset alignment are observable.
drivers: Retracement quality is unresolved until observed

forecast.analysis: Cash-open price discovery and the 14:00 UTC Pending Home Sales release keep conditional Tail near the top of WATCH. Repeated extension after failed pullbacks would be the escalation trigger.
drivers: Failed pullbacks would justify higher Tail

forecast.analysis: After the main data and open sequence, Tail eases conditionally if price discovery becomes two-way; unresolved one-way continuation would keep WATCH active.
With the highest-impact window passing, conditional Tail declines but remains WATCH while the market tests whether early direction can sustain without normal retracements.
drivers: Sustained direction without retracement remains the risk

forecast.analysis: Late-morning U.S. trade should clarify whether the session is directional or rotational. Two-way structure lowers Tail; repeated extension would prevent further decay.
Into midday, conditional Tail returns low if retracements remain meaningful and cross-assets stop reinforcing a single direction; Stress can remain high independently.
drivers: Stress can stay high with low Tail

forecast.analysis: Midday liquidity can exaggerate moves, but absent fresh one-way evidence the base case is low Tail and gradually easing Stress.
drivers: Fresh one-way evidence is required for escalation

forecast.analysis: Early-afternoon risk stays low conditionally; a renewed rates-plus-tech alignment with NQ holding an extreme would be needed to reverse the decay.
drivers: Rates-plus-tech alignment is a conditional amplifier
Extreme holding would invalidate Tail decay

forecast.analysis: Into U.S. power hour, Tail stays low if earlier extremes are not repeatedly extended. Stress remains above normal because post-FOMC repricing is still fresh.
drivers: Repeated extension would matter more than volatility alone

forecast.analysis: Late-session continuation is a checkpoint. Tail remains low if pullbacks persist; sustained extreme-holding with aligned rates and dollar would raise it.
drivers: Rates-dollar alignment can amplify sustained extremes

forecast.analysis: After the cash close, conditional risk normalizes further if the session finishes rotational rather than with unresolved directional extension.
Early Globex liquidity can be thin. Tail remains low under a two-way overnight assumption; any abrupt gap plus failed retracement would invalidate that path.
drivers: Gap plus failed retracement is the invalidation

forecast.analysis: Asia-hours structure is expected to stay lower-risk conditionally, with Stress still elevated by the new Fed tightening regime and geopolitical energy risk.
drivers: Fed tightening regime remains a background driver
Geopolitical energy risk keeps Stress above normal

forecast.analysis: Without a fresh catalyst, conditional Tail remains low; the key invalidation is persistent NQ extension that is not matched by meaningful retracements.
drivers: No scheduled U.S. catalyst in this hour
Persistent NQ extension is the key invalidation

forecast.analysis: Overnight risk remains low conditionally. A stable rates and oil backdrop plus two-way NQ trade would preserve the low-Tail state into the European transition.
drivers: Stable rates backdrop would support low Tail
Easing oil reduces one cross-asset amplifier
Two-way NQ trade is the core condition

forecastDetail.comment: Current low Tail reflects firm futures but no verified persistent no-retracement NQ path; rates and dollar keep Stress high.
Low Tail persists conditionally if the overnight bid remains orderly and meaningful pullbacks continue.
European handoff is a structure checkpoint; shallow retracements with aligned rates would challenge the low-Tail state.
Two-way European price discovery keeps Tail low; persistent directional efficiency would raise it.
Event proximity lifts Stress, but Tail remains low unless one-way NQ structure appears.
Pre-U.S. positioning raises conditional risk modestly; event importance alone does not justify a block.
